history.summary: A 2027-completion 999-year-leasehold 4BR in D19 (Hougang/Kovan area) at $2.4M / $1939 PSF, marketed with a promotional 'cheap' name. Near-freehold tenure and a family-sized layout are positives, but it's 1.16km from Kovan MRT, has no URA track record, and $1939 PSF is full developer/new-launch pricing for OCR D19.
history.rating_rationale: 999yr tenure is effectively freehold and the $2.4M quantum is at the upper edge of the still-workable family band. But this is an unbuilt 2027 new launch with no resale history, $1939 PSF is rich for D19 OCR, and 1.16km to Kovan means no walkable-MRT premium. The clickbait listing name and below-frontier 429 score reinforce that the price leaves little upside. Punggol Digital District/CRL benefit D19 broadly but this pocket is not at the centre of it.
red_flags: New launch (TOP 2027) — no resale URA data; appreciation rate unverifiable and likely developer-inflated
$1939 PSF is full pricing for OCR D19
1.16km / 14 min to Kovan MRT — no station-proximity premium
Promotional listing title and below-frontier score (429) suggest weak relative value
catalysts: 999-year leasehold — near-freehold value retention vs typical 99yr OCR stock
Brand-new completion (2027) commands a freshness premium and full tenancy appeal
D19 broadly benefits from Punggol Digital District and Cross Island Line (~2030)

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: 4BR rents to families in the Hougang/Serangoon catchment; yield modest (~3%) at $2.4M, and distance from MRT slightly caps rent. Family-only tenant pool.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: No URA series; as a new launch at full pricing, near-term appreciation is likely muted until the developer premium is absorbed — model around the OCR ~3.7%/yr baseline.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: OCR/D19 baseline — new launch with no resale URA data, full developer pricing
